title: Andy Kirk
summary: He remembers Kirk's band with Pha Terrell and Mary Lou Williams.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Any comments on the Andy Kirk Band?
Oh, yeah. Andy Kirk with Pha Terrell. I was talking to Andy Kirk other during the day.

Andy Kirk was with Mary Lou Williams, "Until The Real Thing Comes Along". They was beautiful. They was there before I got there. But, I didn't play besides Andy as much as I did with some of the rest of them. But, we all knew each other. You know? We was around. But,

I liked him, and I liked his style. He had some beautiful fellows. Pha Terrell, Mary Lou Williams. I knew, I jammed with her. You know, sat down and had some talks with her, you know, during her jazz time.
And, I'd see Andy off and on every time I'd go by the union. And, I'd get him on the phone and say Andy. Do you know where I can find so and so? You know?
And we still, you know, talk to each other.
